temporalDrift.rule: At least four 60s bins, positive bin-median OLS slope, and last-quartile P25 greater than first-quartile P75; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
confounders: Audio content and decoder workload vary with source time.
Host/GPU contention was not experimentally controlled.

cadenceSustainability.rule: Existing frozen bounded-backlog diagnostic plus final receive-to-start queue delay within the existing 8ms jitter allowance.
cadenceSustainability.scope: Observed finite-session causal cadence only; not a proof of indefinite operation.
